programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: Last Feelings
programme.desc: Diego is a boy with problems. Tartassed at school, he does not find a better climate in his family, harassed as he is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sports club where he can secretly train in swimming, his great sporting passion. There he also finds a couple of loving friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a son. However, fate has a bitter sentence in store.

programme.title: Love hurts
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.
